works.body:
Hello nice to meet you!

I would like to request an illustration of a fox girl character.

I have multiple fox girls!

Please choose 1 fox girl to illustrate. 

Personality details of each fox girl:

Blue: Cool blue fox and stoic girl. She tries too hard to make those around her happy.

Red: Cold bitch girl that is slow to open her heart. But once she opens her heart, the fox girl will love you forever.

Gold: heroine girl with cheat abilities, she will love you unconditionally. 

Green: Closed from the world by her family she lacks any meaningful experiences. A noble daughter that wants a best friend. Amateur novelist.

Black: Noble daughter of a commander. She relies only on herself. She will love someone only conditionally. 

White: a genius stoic mage girl that cares only about her own happiness. Due to growing up in a harsh environment, she has issues learning empathy.

Pink: chaotic shrine maiden that cares only about the happiness of others. She believes summoning many rainbows makes everyone happy, but causes too many rainstorms.

Silver: hard working holy sister. Overworked girl with flawless qualities, but always dealing with unlucky situations. She will complain in her thoughts about insane situations.

Purple: elegant princess with emotion reading abilities. The princess is lonely because everyone is scared of the princess and stays away. 

Dark-blue: a royal maid and retainer, but somewhat professional maid? The maid covers up her mistakes and laziness with brilliant excuses. Often serves a ‘healthy’ hot tea with aromatherapy. (It’s just plain hot water and a candle)

Dark-red: common sense girl. retainer by day, serious assassin girl by night. Skeptical of everything the Dark-blue maid does, but is usually ignored. (Wait isn’t this hot water?)

Orange: 2nd princess. Younger sister of the purple ribbon fox. Plays a Villainous character in order to stand out in the political world. 

Brown: a sweet looking cafe maid boss that runs a cafe shop, she can be very scary. Her family specializes in coffee bean cultivation that grant permanent stat boosts when used in coffee beverages. While a gold fox is a cheat skill character, a brown fox is a cheat item character. The brown ribbon fox’s strength stat is super high, she can grind coffee beans with one hand or use them as projectiles.

All the details of the illustration are left to you. Anything is fine. 

Thank you very much for your time!
